title: A nourishing bowl
description: Caller-ordered horizontal amounts with labels above quiet, warm marks.

props.name: data
props.description: Caller-ordered { id, label, value, tone? } rows with unique nonempty IDs. Finite nonnegative values are measured amounts; null, negative and non-finite values are unavailable. Zero retains its reading without a bar. Optional tone a–d identifies a category; the default is a. Long labels retain their full text in tooltips.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned measurement heading and tooltip unit. Defaults to Value.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned context beside the unit heading.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats direct readings, numeric-axis ticks and tooltips. Defaults to en-US numbers with at most two decimal places.

props.name: animate
props.description: Defaults to true; scoped finite motion honors live reduced-motion changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional container classes. The chart fills its parent; dense plots scroll locally.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible chart title. Arrow keys inspect observations through Recharts.
